subject: Dual-route payment plan for Invoice 7782
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Maria Torres <maria.torres@ambertech.com>, AP Team <ap@ambertech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dual-route payment plan for Invoice 7782

Hi Maria / AP team,

Quick follow-up on Invoice 7782 (due 06/10) — I see the invoice is still showing as unpaid in our ledger. We want to minimize disruption on your side and offer a dual-route to ensure funds land within this week:

- Option A (preferred): ACH / bank transfer to the account on the attached invoice (should clear in 1–3 business days).
- Option B (backup): Process via virtual card. If the card declines, please switch to a wire using the same reference (Inv 7782).

Two quick asks so we can unblock:
1) Can you confirm which route AP will take and an expected settlement ETA?
2) We need your VAT ID for invoicing purposes (AmberTech's VAT is currently blank in our system). If you have any withholding documentation requirements, please send those over.

I've attached Invoice_7782.pdf and a short AP_PaymentOptions.xlsx that lists the bank rails and our preferred wire reference. If you prefer a phone call to run through the fallback plan, happy to hop on with Neha.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn here.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: Invoice_7782.pdf (invoice, PDF, 1 page); AP_PaymentOptions.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

From: Maria Torres <maria.torres@ambertech.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dual-route payment plan for Invoice 7782

Thanks Ben — sorry for the delay. We attempted to run the virtual card last week but the transaction exceeded our single-card monthly limit and declined. AP is asking for wiring instructions and a beneficiary name that exactly matches our bank records to avoid rejections.

A few items from our side:
- We can wire, but will need the invoice to show the VAT line explicitly and the beneficiary legal name (we need this for bank compliance).
- Please share the wire remittance reference format (so our payment references to you match the ledger).
- If you have a signed W-9/W-8 (depending on entity) please attach — AP needs tax documentation on file for cross-border wires.

If we can get the VAT line and beneficiary name today, we'll queue the wire for Monday morning and confirm when the funds leave.

Hi Maria — great, thanks for the quick note. To make this as smooth as possible, we propose the following exit plan:

1) Retry virtual card today with a reduced amount split (we can issue two smaller virtual cards if helpful). If the card clears, excellent — please mark remittance to "Inv 7782".
2) If the card declines again, proceed with a wire within 48 hours. Wire instructions (use exact beneficiary):
   - Bank: Northern Pacific Bank
   - Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - Account: XXXXXXXX (please reference attached AP_PaymentOptions.xlsx for full details)
   - Wire reference: AMB-7782 / INV 7782

3) For VAT and tax: Our accounting team confirms the attached invoice now includes an explicit VAT line and our US tax docs are available on request (we can attach a W-9). If you need a different legal beneficiary name for EU wires, tell us the exact string and we will update the invoice immediately.

I'll attach an updated copy of Invoice_7782.pdf with the VAT line included and the remittance reference called out. Neha — looping you here to confirm we can issue split virtual cards if AP prefers that route.

Ben
